*The Crisis* was published monthly from 1910-1934. Browse Du Bois's contributions by volume and issue.

## Volume Organization

Each volume of *The Crisis* typically covered one year, with 6-12 issues per volume.

### Early Years (1910-1914)

- [Volume 1 (Nov 1910 - Oct 1911)](../Volumes/01/) - The founding year
- [Volume 2 (May 1911 - Apr 1912)](../Volumes/02/) - Establishing the voice
- [Volume 3 (Nov 1911 - Oct 1912)](../Volumes/03/) - Growing influence
- [Volume 4 (May 1912 - Apr 1913)](../Volumes/04/)
- [Volume 5 (Nov 1912 - Oct 1913)](../Volumes/05/)
- [Volume 6 (May 1913 - Apr 1914)](../Volumes/06/)
- [Volume 7 (Nov 1913 - Oct 1914)](../Volumes/07/)

### World War I Era (1915-1919)

- [Volume 8-17](../Volumes/) - The Great Migration and WWI

### 1920s: Post-War & Harlem Renaissance

- [Volume 18-35](../Volumes/) - Jazz Age and cultural flowering

### Depression Era (1930-1934)

- [Volume 36-41](../Volumes/) - Economic crisis and Du Bois's final years at The Crisis
